text:
alexa_sales: Customer (FinSaaS APAC) — major constraint: all traffic + logs must remain in APAC; they want written proof that requests won't leave APAC, list of subprocessors, and certificate chain for any third party. POC next Tues. Can we confirm availability and whether we can enforce fail-closed routing? cc @jorge_eng @sarah_security

jorge_eng: Short answer: yes, but depends on model availability in the chosen APAC region. Hosted routing defaults to nearest region with fallbacks; we can pin region and set fail_closed. If model variant isn't available there we either need dedicated/private or a compatible smaller variant.

sarah_security: I can assemble the subprocessor registry + cert chain and SOC2 artifacts. Need to confirm which APAC region they require (e.g., asia-northeast1 vs asia-southeast1) and whether KMS must be customer-owned and located in APAC.

alexa_sales: They insist on asia-northeast1 (Tokyo) and will not accept KMS in any other region. Also they explicitly require "no cross-border fallthrough" — if we can't serve, request must fail.

jorge_eng: We can provide a routing policy that enforces that. Example config for the POC (we'll provide this as a config snippet):
```json
{
  "routing_policy": "region_pin",
  "region": "asia-northeast1",
  "fail_closed": true,
  "fallback_models": []
}
```
Note: hosted endpoints still require an available model build in that region. Large models >GPU memory may not be built for every region; if it's not available, hosted will return an error under fail_closed. Dedicated pool or Private deploy guarantees local capacity.

mike_cs: Operationally we can stand up a small dedicated pool in APAC in ~48-72 hours for a POC if they sign off. For quick proof we could also use a lighter quantized model that fits into local GPUs — Jorge, can you list compatible variants for asia-northeast1?

bryan_finance: Ballpark POC pricing: dedicated pool (equivalent node to p3) is ~USD 7-12k/mo depending on GPU type; for a 2-week POC we can pro-rate and offer a discounted short-term rate. Egress inside same cloud region is negligible; cross-region/cloud egress is charged and could be material if fallbacks are allowed.

sarah_security: For the cert/subprocessor pack I will bundle: cloud provider certs, logging/monitoring subprocessors, CDN/edge partners, and our CA chain. I will also include a contact for SOC2 + penetration test report retrieval. Please have the customer's SIG/Q completed and we can map answers quickly.

alexa_sales: They prefer the SIG format. I'll collect and upload it when received. Also they asked if we support an on-prem/private deploy where they keep keys and logs entirely on-prem. Jorge, what's the friction and ETA?

jorge_eng: Private deployment is supported but heavier: needs customer infra, network peering (or air-gapped bundle), HSM/KMS integration for keys, and the customer will run our control-plane agent or accept an air-gapped bundle. Onboarding ops estimate: 2-4 weeks for a minimal Private POC (shorter if customer has infra automation ready). For speed, Dedicated in APAC is the fastest path to meet their "no cross-border" rule.

deploy-bot: deploy: apac-dedicated-request created (#1234) — provisioning ETA ~60h — owner: eng-oncall

alexa_sales: Next steps: (1) Sarah to send subproc + cert bundle, (2) Jorge to provide the list of compatible model variants and the routing JSON for the POC, (3) Bryan to send a POC pricing estimate and pro-rate option, (4) I will upload the customer's SIG and confirm final acceptance criteria. Anything else? :thumbsup:
